title: X2: The lillist CLI opens a third, different store path

description: StoreLocator builds <group>/Library/Application Support/Lillist/Lillist.sqlite; appGroupOnDisk (used by iOS) builds <group>/Lillist/Lillist.sqlite; the macOS app uses neither (see X1). Three path conventions across six processes, pinned together by no test. The CLI therefore always throws 'store not found', or - worse, if a stale file happens to exist at its path - silently operates on a divergent, out-of-sync copy. Severity: Critical. Wave/Plan: Wave 1, plan 1c store-location-unification. Sweep: cross-process. Verified directly against source. Keystone: multi-process test harness (two PersistenceControllers on one store file) + path-pin test; later waves (5b, X20 stress) build on it.
